Resolves the routed low/verification concern and operator battery
items 1-5. One commit only: the runner owns git, so the pass could not
commit after each numbered item.

Low concern (lossy passthrough): the "summary is stored and re-bounded

{Tests:[TestA], Lossy:true} and asserts the stored row keeps lossy=true.
Counterfactual: `Lossy: in.Lossy` -> `Lossy: false` in
boundMergeCandidateFailureSummary -> RED ("runner-lossy summary: stored
... Lossy:false"). Restored.

Item 1 (F2): runner/internal/upload adds shrinkMergeCandidateBodyFields
and shrinkFieldToFit. ShipPullRequest shrinks the MARSHALLED
merge_candidate_verified body under MaxPullRequestReportBytes in this
order: the excerpt's largest fitting head, then the tail's largest
fitting end, then the summary's tests list dropped (on a copy) with
lossy=true. TestShipPullRequest_MergeCandidateEscapeHeavyBodyFits uses a
server that 413s over the cap, plus an excerpt of `<` and a tail of
`\x01`. TestShrinkMergeCandidateBodyFields_Ladder pins the rung order.
Counterfactuals, each restored:
- shrink call removed -> RED (413, 73796-byte body, verdict lost).
- rung 3 removed -> RED (ladder "did not fit: 42450 bytes").
- rung 1 skipped -> RED (49187-byte body, 413).
The old claim that the raw bounds alone keep the body under the cap is
corrected in the upload.go const doc, the ShipPullRequest case comment
and runner/cmd/fishhawk-runner/README.md. The OpenAPI `lossy`
description now names the tests-list drop.
